summary: Replace engine oil and oil filter as part of routine service.
steps: 1. Warm up engine 5 min then shut off. 2. Remove engine undertray. 3. Remove drain plug, drain oil into pan. 4. Remove oil filter housing cap, replace filter element and both O-rings. 5. Reinstall drain plug and filter cap. 6. Refill with correct oil, check level.
torque_specs: Oil drain plug: 25 Nm; Oil filter housing cap: 25 Nm
part_numbers: Oil filter element: 11427566327; Drain plug washer: 07119963130; Engine oil: 5W-30 LL-01, 6.5 L with filter
tools_needed: Oil filter housing wrench (36mm), drain pan, torque wrench
notes_warnings: Don't overtighten the filter cap, it's plastic and cracks easily. Let oil drain fully, takes longer than people expect.
source: my own experience doing this 10+ times

summary: Replace front brake pads and inspect rotors.
steps: 1. Loosen wheel bolts, jack up car, remove wheel. 2. Remove caliper guide bolts. 3. Lift caliper off, support with wire, don't let it hang on the brake line. 4. Remove old pads and anti-rattle clips. 5. Compress piston with tool. 6. Install new pads and clips. 7. Reinstall caliper, torque guide bolts. 8. Pump brake pedal before driving.
torque_specs: Caliper guide bolts: 30 Nm; Wheel bolts: 120 Nm
part_numbers: Front brake pads: 34116794914; Anti-rattle clip set: 34116765813
tools_needed: Caliper piston tool, torque wrench, jack and stands
notes_warnings: Reset the brake pad wear sensor if equipped, or the dash light stays on. Bed in new pads with a few gentle stops before hard braking.
